t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It is a good idea to choose the clour of knomes that your are not so keen on when it is at 1x just to see which colour knomes are better at getting your more mushrooms and not during when it is at 5x . Take notice of the colour pattern of the knomes together as they remain the same.  Also try to take time to stretch anf refresh during breaks

vb_textbox.text: There seems to be a pattern when choosing the knomes, whereas the colours of the knomes are grouped together, however, for example, if the red knome is on the left and the yellow knome is on the right it is best to choose which one gave you more points on either the left or right side.  It is also helpful to not always choose the colour that your favor all the time.
